hints.title: Information Theoretic Candidate Pruning
hints.text: When a guessed word receives match count M from the master referee, any true target word must share exactly M matching character positions with that guess.

hints.title: Minimax Word Selection Strategy
hints.text: Pick a word that minimizes the maximum possible remaining candidate set size across all potential referee response outcomes (0 through 6).

hints.title: Guess Loop Blueprint
hints.text: While candidates remain: evaluate each candidate word to compute worst-case remaining bucket size, pick the best candidate, call master.guess, and filter candidate list keeping only words with identical match count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Minimax pairwise word comparison takes O(N^2 * L) per iteration; candidates shrink exponentially.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Random guessing without candidate pruning has less than 1% probability of finding secret word in 10 attempts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering candidate list shrinks search space drastically after each referee feedback.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understanding minimax entropy optimization to eliminate maximum wrong words per guess.
